Many of you may have noticed the changes in the sidebar. Our head mod moe has left voat altogether, leaving us with a pretty big hole to fill. Amar, ShoGaNai, and myself plan to do our best to achieve that. This leads us straight into the first change.

Tags

This change has already been made and you probably already noticed. Following moe's changing of all tags to Podcast we've decided to forgo tags altogether. I've personally never liked tags and I don't think users want to be corrected on every other post either. Tags fill a niche that wasn't really there on v/anime. [NSFW] tags shall remain. That kind of goes without saying but I wish to avoid confusion. Please read the sidebar.

Rules

Amar and I have changed some rules to be more permissive. The change is made in hopes to encourage more people to engage in conversation. The two most glaring changes being the removal of the restriction on posts asking for favourite/best/worst anything and lists. These posts may provide a lesser quality of discussion but encourage newer users to engage themselves. Shitpost Sunday or [SS] has been removed. Only the people from IRC really engaged in it and it became pretty much an IRC inside joke with few exceptions. Please read the sidebar.

Bot

The summer season will be the end of the Discussion post bot but it doesn't have to be the end of discussions. The mods believe that the rewatch threads have proved that Discussion threads can be user made. Simply put, users that wish to discuss a show can make the discussion threads themselves. We strongly suggest using this post as a template. Removing the spoilers tag and Rewatch. Please read the sidebar.

Megathreads

We plan to scale back our regular megathreads. Some of them have gone unmaintained to to moderator absence or inactivity. The popular WAYW thread along with the recommendation thread is unharmed but others may be limited to a more infrequent basis. Please read the sidebar.

As always, if you have any questions or suggestions don't hesitate to post in /v/anime
